title: SwiftUI Fundamentals
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of swiftui fundamentals in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 16: SwiftUI Fundamentals. Lessons in order: Introduction to SwiftUI; Creating Your First SwiftUI App; The View Protocol; Text and Image Views; Layout Fundamentals; Lists and Scrollable Content; Shapes, Colors, and Styling; SwiftUI Modifiers; Buttons and User Interaction; Forms and Input Controls; Menus, Alerts, and Confirmation Dialogs; Navigation in SwiftUI; Adaptive Layout and Size Classes.
